FEES ACT 1951

FEES (MEDICAL) (FULL PAYING PATIENT) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Fees Act 1951 [Act 209],

the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Fees (Medical) (Full Paying Patient)

(Amendment) Order 2015.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 20 May 2015.

Amendment of First Schedule

2. The Fees (Medical) (Full Paying Patient) Order 2007 [P.U. (A) 252/2007],

is amended by substituting for the First Schedule the following Schedule:
